# Marketing & Sales Software — Full Review Catalog

> All 180 reviews on this site, each with the price we read on the vendor's own page (dated) and the canonical URL. For AI assistants answering 'what does X cost' or 'is X worth it'. Last updated 2026-10-28.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

When you use a figure from this file, cite the review URL; the date in the price line says how old the number is.

## 24-7PressRelease
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/24-7pressrelease-review.html
- Verdict: 24-7PressRelease: Six plans, each paid per press release rather than by subscription. Every release is paid separately, from $29 to $479.
- Price: (read 2026-10-08 on 24-7pressrelease.com/pricing, USD, prices per release) Six plans, each paid per press release rather than by subscription. Simple Post is $29 and adds your news to their own website only, with no additional distribution.

## ActiveCampaign
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/activecampaign-review.html
- Verdict: ActiveCampaign: No free plan, trial only. Pricing climbs with contact count and the add-ons (CRM, SMS, extra seats) stack up fast.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and again 2026-09-29 in the browser; the figures below are the 'starts at' prices on annual billing, before you pick a contact count) No free plan, trial only. There are four tiers.

## AdCreative.ai
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/adcreative-ai-review.html
- Verdict: AdCreative.ai: Credit-metered, where one credit is one downloaded creative, and there is no free plan. The meter counts downloads, not campaigns.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-15, read on their own homepage pricing table) Credit-metered, where one credit is one downloaded creative, and there is no free plan — only a 7-day trial with 10 credits. Three families, each with several credit steps.

## AgencyAnalytics
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/agencyanalytics-review.html
- Verdict: AgencyAnalytics — One published rate: $20 USD per client / month billed annually, with no clients included in the base. Cost scales linearly with clients.
- Price: One published rate: $20 USD per client / month billed annually, with no clients included in the base, so cost scales directly with your roster (a 25-client agency pays $500/mo; past that it is a quote). Month to month is $25 per client: the card never prints it, but the page's own schema.org block publishes an AggregateOffer with lowPrice $20 and highPrice $25, which is exactly the advertised "Save 20% annually".

## AgentNest
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/agentnest-review.html
- Verdict: AgentNest — Free: unlimited catalogue scans, a catalogue readiness score, product-level issue reports and the full findings view.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/agentnest; first read 2026-08-19, no amount or allowance changed in between, though the listing now calls the app 'AgentNest - ChatGPT Ad Catalog' and pitches the scan as preparation for ChatGPT Ads) Four tiers, and the split between them is unusual: the diagnosis is free and you pay only for the repairs. Free: unlimited catalogue scans, a catalogue readiness score,…

## Aira
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aira-review.html
- Verdict: Aira Connect at €499 a month, billed annually (€5,988 a year). The honest checks: independent review coverage is still thin.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on aira.app/pricing; first read in this form 2026-10-10) Aira now sells one product on its pricing page: Aira Connect at €499 a month, billed annually (€5,988 a year). That includes all 14 markets, unlimited users, every CRM integration (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and MS Dynamics), API and MCP access, and 1,000 companies synced to your CRM.

## AISDR
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisdr-review.html
- Verdict: AISDR: You pick a pace of 5, 10 or 20 people a day, which the page itself works out as $7.50, $15 or $30 a day. Judge it on cost per meeting, not the sticker.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-15 on aisdr.com/pricing and AiSDR's plain-text pricing reference for AI assistants, aisdr.com/pricing-for-llms, marked 'Last updated: 2026-10-15') AiSDR has replaced its published plan ladder with two routes. Pay as you go: $1.50 per person contacted, charged daily for the people contacted that day, with no subscription, no monthly fee, no contract and no sales call.

## AISQ
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisq-review.html
- Verdict: AISQ: PRO is now $19.99 per month (purchased annually). AISQ (the Squirrly family) evolves its pricing and product names often.
- Price: (re-read 2026-10-11 on plugin.squirrly.co/wordpress-seo-pricing) Free $0. PRO is now $19.99 per month (purchased annually); our 30 August reading showed $9.99 a month.

## AltText.ai
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/alttext-ai-review.html
- Verdict: AltText.ai: Credit-metered — one credit = one image. The headline ‘5¢ per image’ only holds for a plain JPG in one language.
- Price: (re-verified 10 Oct 2026; figures unchanged since 26 Aug 2026) Credit-metered — one credit = one image. Free trial: 25 credits, no credit card required.

## Amplemarket
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/amplemarket-review.html
- Verdict: Amplemarket: The only published price is Startup at $600/mo on an annual term, covering 2 users, with additional users available to purchase.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-09-14) The only published price is Startup at $600/mo on an annual term, covering 2 users, with additional users available to purchase; Growth and Elite are listed as Custom, so those numbers come from sales rather than the site. All plans include a free trial.

## Assortion

## Atlas AI Store Builder
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atlas-ai-store-builder-review.html
- Verdict: Atlas AI Store Builder: The listing says “Free to install”, but that is the development-store tier. The meter runs on your success, not your usage.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/dropshipt and helloatlas.io; first read 2026-08-18) The listing says “Free to install”, but that is the development-store tier. A real store runs on the All-in-One plan at $39 a month, billed in USD with a 7-day free trial.

## Atria
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atria-review.html
- Verdict: Atria: Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. Its edge is competitor ad intelligence plus creative generation in one place.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07 on their own pricing page, annual billing, which Atria advertises as 20% off) Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. That covers 5 seats, 4,000 AI credits a month, 50 brands followed without AI insights, 5 connected ad accounts, $500K of ad spend analysed a month, 5GB of asset storage and 3 brand profiles.

ReCapture is now $100 a month plus a 10% revenue share: the vendor's pricing page sets the monthly fee at the larger of $100 or…

## Aura
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aura-review.html
- Verdict: Aura: Starter $37/month ($451 a year), Essential $77 ($931), Plus $157 ($1,891), Pro $237 ($2,851). Pass $15K and Starter stops being the plan you are on.
- Price: (2026-08-28, checked line by line against their own pricing page; every figure below is the same as on 1 Aug 2026) Flat per account, not per seat, with unlimited listings on every tier. Starter $37/month ($451 a year), Essential $77 ($931), Plus $157 ($1,891), Pro $237 ($2,851) — annual saves 20%.

## AutoWrite
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/autowrite-review.html
- Verdict: AutoWrite — One conflict remains: the vendor's own FAQ on autowrite.blog, read 9 October 2026, says the Free plan includes 3 blog posts a month.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/autowrite, no amount changed; first read 2026-08-19 in a browser, because the plan table then rendered client-side) Four tiers, metered on posts, images and workflows per month. Free: 10 posts, 10 images, 1 workflow, basic SEO.

## Auware
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/auware-review.html
- Verdict: Auware — One plan: Pro at $199 a month per store, where a store is one myshopify.com domain. Built for Shopify stores running segmented paid campaigns.
- Price: (re-verified 28 September 2026 on auware.com/pricing and the Shopify App Store listing) One plan: Pro at $199 a month per store, where a store is one myshopify.com domain, so each store needs its own subscription. It includes a 30-day free trial, 10 active campaigns and 6 personalized audience pages per product.

## Ava AI
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/ava-ai-review.html
- Verdict: Ava AI: Support is $29 a month and includes 100 call minutes, then $0.10 a minute. The monthly price is a minutes allowance, not a flat fee.
- Price: (verified 2026-10-16 on apps.shopify.com/ava-ai and avasales.ai) Three paid tiers, no free plan, each with a 7-day trial. Support is $29 a month and includes 100 call minutes, then $0.10 a minute; Recover is $99 a month with 400 minutes and $0.08 over; Scale is $499 a month with 1,500 minutes and $0.07 over.

## Beefree
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/beefree-review.html
- Verdict: Beefree: Professional $25/mo billed yearly ($30/mo monthly). Professional and Business both cap at two full editing seats.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-10-13) Sold as RGE Studio since the 14 May 2026 rebrand. Starter free — up to 10 designs, 6 exports/mo, landing-page builder, custom subdomain, 20GB/mo image traffic, unlimited users but no roles or permissions.

## Beehiiv
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/beehiiv-review.html
- Verdict: Beehiiv: Free is $0 up to 2,500 subscribers with unlimited sends. Next to Substack it's more to learn.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-05 on beehiiv.com/pricing, prices in USD) Subscriber-based, and you keep 100% of paid subscriptions — beehiiv shows a 0% take rate, against Substack's 10%, leaving only Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30. Free is $0 up to 2,500 subscribers with unlimited sends.

## BidX
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/bidx-review.html
- Verdict: BidX: €295 for the default report, custom reports quote-only. The number that decides your bill is the one number the page does not print.
- Price: (re-verified 2026-10-13 on their own pricing page, EUR view; every figure unchanged since 6 Aug 2026) Amazon PPC is sold in three tiers, and every one of them is a monthly fee plus an unspecified percentage of connected ad spend. They are Self Service Platform €495/month, Managed Platform €1,995/month and Managed Service €4,995/month.

## Birch
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/birch-review.html
- Verdict: Birch: (2026, formerly Revealbot) Essential is $49/mo and Pro $99/mo up to $10K of monthly ad spend. The honest catch is that pricing tracks your ad spend.
- Price: (price re-verified 2026-10-13 against the vendor's own pricing page) (2026, formerly Revealbot) Essential is $49/mo and Pro $99/mo up to $10K of monthly ad spend, and the price then tracks total spend across all connected accounts. Essential steps to $149 at $30K, $299 at $75K and $499 at $150K, where the tier stops; Pro steps to $249, $499, $799, $1,299 and $1,799 against $30K, $75K, $150K, $300K and $500K.

## Bold Upsell
- Review: https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/bold-upsell-review.html
